name: lecend
description: Look up the short labels of a long Claude Code session (/lecend W6) and see them in a side pane, without asking the model.

model.title: Capture model
model.description: The model lecend sends each captured turn to (an alias such as haiku, or a full model id). Calls are billed to your Claude account.

capture.title: Capture
capture.description: Capture labels in the background by sending each turn's text to the capture model. Off: lecend never calls a model.

budgetPerSession.title: Model calls per session
budgetPerSession.description: The most capture model calls one session makes; capture stops when it is reached.

stoplist.title: Ignored labels
stoplist.description: Comma-separated labels that are never captured, on top of the built-in list (for example: DKIM, SPF).
